checks: The sheared cylinder is convex and its three integer slices are actual unit disks with centers (z,0). In the section x_2=−z/2 the chord center is (z,−z/2) and its length is 2√(1−z²/4), giving the stated lengths.

The two outer lifted chord centers are opposite with equal length. The middle chord center is zero. Thus the full centroid is zero. The raw weighted cross moment Σ_z z∫x dν_z is (2√3,−√3), and multiplying by −1/2 gives the section-height contraction.

Central symmetry pairs masses in any closed halfspace through zero and shows its mass is at least half. The two oblique through-origin caps have mixed-boundary area zero and therefore attain equality. The exact statement matches original §3.2.
